criteria.criterion: Use Slack global search with link/file-focused filtering across the workspace
criteria.final_justification: Evidence confirms the agent did use Slack global search with a link-focused filter/operator workspace-wide. This matches the criterion intent; no adjustment needed.

criteria.criterion: Collect up to 20 most recent accessible messages containing shared links or files
criteria.final_justification: The UI evidence shows accessible, newest-sorted results were available; the agent could have continued collecting up to 20 without needing to open external links. The final output contains zero collected resources, so this is a controllable failure rather than an uncontrollable blocker. Keep a low score but nonzero because the agent did reach the correct results view.

No resources were actually reported, so no deduplication was performed. Despite ambiguity in whether same-named files are identical, the agent still needed to deduplicate any reported identical URLs/files; since nothing was reported, score remains 0.

criteria.criterion: Report required fields for each resource
criteria.final_justification: Even partial extraction would have been possible from Slack UI without opening external links, but the agent’s output contains no per-resource reporting at all, so the criterion is not satisfied.

criteria.criterion: Group resources into the specified categories
criteria.final_justification: Because the agent did not produce any resource list, it also did not group anything into the required categories. Score remains 0.

criteria.criterion: Do not open external links or download files
criteria.final_justification: This is a clear violation: the agent opened an external link (resulting in an Auth0 login page). Even though they navigated back afterward, the constraint is violated, so no credit.
No evidence of modifying Slack content; criterion satisfied fully.
